verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented GlitchTip dashboard showing cross-project or cross-team error trends, top regressions, new issues per release, or volume over time. The vague 'Deeper reporting' blog mention gives no details. The only related path is exploring GlitchTip data in Grafana, an external tool, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. The homepage also states 'No dashboard building' (in a performance context).

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can see error trends across projects and teams on dashboards — top regressions, new issues per release, volume over time

citations.quote: Now you should be able to explore your GlitchTip data in Grafana.
